THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
CITY ORNAMENT
034
44 / Office Gold
A candid 1990s office scene: straight brown hair with a
center part, a black lace high-neck top under a gold-flecked
sequin mini dress, a black velvet blazer and glossy black
knee-high boots. She sits at an old wooden desk beside a beige
CRT computer.
45 / Taupe Shearling
A candid portrait in the back seat of a car: straight
platinum-blonde hair with a center part, a calm cool gaze, a
taupe oversized shearling jacket with a diagonal gold zipper and
wide cuffs, and a gold ring. A Parisian street with cream buildings
and bare trees shows through the window.
